title: Rewiring of Inspection Quarters, Visitors Rest room, and Reception centre at Mahabalipuram Lighthouse
summary: E-tender (two-cover) for rewiring of the Inspection Quarters, visitors' rest room and reception centre at Mahabalipuram Lighthouse, Tamil Nadu (Chennai Directorate).

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai

sites.name: Mahabalipuram Lighthouse
sites.work: Rewiring of Inspection Quarters, visitors' rest room and reception centre

scope.item: Rewiring of Inspection Quarters, Visitors Rest room, and Reception centre

money.notes: Estimated cost including GST. EMD by DD/FDR of any nationalised/RBI-approved bank in favour of The Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai, payable at Chennai; valid 90 days from technical bid opening; exempted for valid MSME/NSIC certificate.

eligibility: OEMs or authorised agents, or appropriate class contractors registered with CPWD/State PWD/Railways/MES/BSNL or other State/Central Govt/PSU/autonomous bodies, having experience in electrification, rewiring of buildings and UG cable works (Hindi version also mentions street light pole erection)
notes: Scanned Section 1 NIT only (printed pages 3-4); no BOQ. Download, bid submission and EMD submission 10.10.2025 10:00 to 22.10.2025 15:00; technical bid opening 23.10.2025 15:30. Bid validity not stated.
